text:
mira: quick RFC follow-up: after yesterday's meeting i'm drafting the allocatorhanges. primary goals: fail-fast auth, preserve kv cache locality, and enable SLA-driven pool selection.
dan: prefer auth in allocator to avoid unnecessary executor work. agree on small auth cache + push invalidation for admin events.
kevin: concern: if allocator keeps the cache and does routing, we could fragment warm KV caches. suggestion: cohort keys = (tenant_namespace, model_family, quant_profile) and add short sticky affinity (4s) so in-flight prefixes reuse the same executor.
yasmin: sticky affinity helps but we need to measure hit amplification on cold start. plan: seed warmers for top 50 tenants and an on-demand prefetch path for first request that returns 202 + async warm.
mira: on-demand prefetch may change caller semantics. we should only do async warm for non-blocking ops. For interactive flows, allocator should synchronously route to a hot pool if available, otherwise fallback to a general pool.
dan: fallback pools need lower-cost variants (quantized) to maintain latency SLOs. routing policy: if SLA=low-latency then prefer fresh-hot replicas; else prefer cost-optimized variants.
kevin: auth invalidation strategy: short TTL (15s) + admin push webhook + audit log of allow/deny decisions. we should expose auth_stale_count metric.
yasmin: tests: (1) revoke-smoke: flip role and expect deny within 15s. (2) cache-fragmentation perf: simulate skewed prefixes and measure kv_hit_rate and p95 with cohort routing on/off.
deploy-bot: rollout: feature-flagged canary scheduled for infra-canary at 2026-04-10T02:30Z
mira: metrics to watch during canary: p50/p95 latency, kv_hit_rate, auth_stale_rate, shard_imbalance_ratio, 5xx_rate, cost_per_token. rollback criteria: p95 +20% OR auth_stale_rate > 3% OR 5xx_rate increase > 0.7%.
dan: i'll own allocator auth + webhook (CONSOLE-1604). kevin: i'll own cohort keying and affinity (CONSOLE-1605). yasmin: i'll own warmers + perf harness (CONSOLE-1606).
mira: follow-ups tracked. will post a short decision note in the RFC thread and add a small diagram. sync on friday to review canary metrics.
